shared_elements: low-relief carving on weathered stone in an excavation setting
animal in profile with rounded head and limbs
horizontal band of repeated pattern (zigzag/net-like register)
carved surfaces bounded by raised edges
justification: Both show shallow relief carving on rough pale stone in situ, and each includes profile quadrupeds, serpentine ribbon-like forms and at least one horizontal band of repeated pattern, which is the most specific correspondence. But B is a single tall slab with a strictly stacked, register-based composition and smoothly modelled, fairly naturalistic creatures, while A sprawls across a cluster of boulders in a dense, non-registered field of hard-edged curvilinear and spiral outlines, so the organising logic and carving manner differ substantially.
